notes.title: Big Update - Updated Demo Out Now !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041880/5f8c6fe5221d2787bd20df91777a4a859946552a.png[/img]

This new and updated version includes new systems such as [b]Item Merging[/b] and a complete [b]Talent Tree[/b] to unlock and discover. Also many [b]Quality of Life[/b] and [b]visual improvements[/b] had been added.

Discover more than [b]40 weapons[/b] and over [b]180 items, equipment and relics[/b].

Check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116620/Backpack_Survivors_Demo?utm_source=steam_announcements&utm_campaign=demo_updated&utm_medium=web]the demo[/url] and let us know what you think of it !


We are very excited to have made the next step towards an [b]Early Access Release[/b] and would love to hear your thoughts.

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/z4b8aHtXYK]Discord[/url] to follow development, check out the [b]Roadmap[/b] and share your awesome builds with others.


Happy Gaming !


Chris & Martijn
CM Game Studio

notes.title: Devlog - Build 83
notes.content:
Note: These weekly updates will now be called devlogs instead of "Build XX released". A community member helpfully noted that putting out updates with "released" in the title gives the impression that the updates we talk about are in the demo, as that is the only publicly available build for our game. The updates we put out are actually stuff we have been working on that week for the full release of the game. Some of these features will be included in an updated version of the demo, but we have no time yet as when that will be.

For now, these devlogs will give you insight in what we are working on. If you have any questions or remakrs about these, feel free to message us.

And now for the meat of the devlog:

Features:
- Polished Cave Level
- Debuffs are now visible on Boss Healthbar
- Added settings to disable screen flash / screen shake
- Added a chance for getting 50% off in the shop
- Added various new weapons and items
- Added Health Regen as a new stat
- Added environmental traps in levels
- Added formulas as a way of calculating stats (ie: +1 armor for every 10% luck you have)


Fixes:
- Fixed buffs still showing after death / revive
- Fixed explosion damage not scaling with player buffs
- Fixed/polished new shop offer UI
- Fixed coin change text popups flying in
- Fixed Adventure Completed UI

notes.title: Backpack Survivors - Demo out now !
notes.content:
Backpack Survivors - Demo released !

The public demo for Backpack Survivors has just been released.
We have worked almost 9 months on this game and are finally ready to release the first part of the game to the public.
It is still a work in progress and there will be rough edges and unbalance, but we are ready to see you all try the game.

In the demo you can fight your way through an adventure containing 2 mini-bosses, an end boss plus many mobs to fight.
This way you can get a glimpse of what is coming in the full game.

We hope you will enjoy your time in Backpack Survivors !
Keep filling that backpack !

- Chris & Martijn 
CM Game Studio


PS
If you encounter any issues, please tell us about them on our Discord or use the in game Feedback functionality.
We will be updating the demo in case there are still any major issues, so let us know and we can work on it.
